blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has issued rules on market making to improve liquidity and price discovery in the Philippine capital market, setting a P150-million minimum capital requirement for qualified trading participants. SEC Memorandum Circular No. 28, Series of 2026, issued on Oct. 15, establishes eligibility requirements, trading obligations and safeguards for […]...
